description: Set the interpolation type of an existing keyframe (Linear, Hold, or Bezier). Premiere exposes no interpolation readback, so a write is reported as committed_unverified. Stored curves do not establish rendering; verify with a short video export, or with PNG stills composited over black (they carry straight alpha).

property_index.description: Optional property index from get_effect_properties; required when property_name is duplicated.

time_seconds.description: Seconds from the clip's start on the timeline (0 is the clip's first frame) of the keyframe

name: set_keyframe_interpolation

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Set Keyframe Interpolation
